connector.name: Lithium Vault MCP
connector.registryDescription: Primary-source lithium & battery-metals mining data (AISC, reserves, filings) via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package lithium-vault-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ciinkwia account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
env.description: Coinbase CDP API key ID for the wallet that pays the per-call USDC fee

env.name: CDP_ACCOUNT_NAME
env.description: Named CDP account to pay from (default: lithium-vault-mcp)

env.name: VAULT_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the vault endpoint base URL (default: https://clink-lithium-vault.fly.dev)

env.name: X402_MAX_PRICE
env.description: Max USD price per call the server will pay before refusing (default: 0.25)
